audit_scope: Host reviews accepted the normalized zero-band deduction, full one-critical obstruction, quantitative smoothing, and nonzero-tube embedded realization. The current direct transport proof supplies the remaining implication, including all signs and cutoff derivatives, spatial-boundary control, full regularity, uniform full-vertical error, a Hamiltonian-fixed finite subdivision and the fixed S^9 stable class. Its composition supports the main theorem but remains open for Host-invoked independent review. No AIS lemma is invoked or silently certified; no new novelty, kernel-topology or campaign-completion claim is made.

definitions.Tkl: The C^1 path component of q|S^{k+l-1} among angular functions having 0 as a regular value.
definitions.stable_tubes: The based telescope of T_{m,m} under addition of q_{1,1}; unequal positive/negative additions enter this telescope by cofinality.
definitions.gamma: Stable spherical fibration of the negative domains D(h)={h<=0}; gamma:T->BG.
definitions.H: Smooth h-cobordism space with identified incoming manifold, collared product vertical boundary, and unparametrized outgoing boundary.
definitions.Hs: The interval-product stabilization telescope of H.
definitions.normalized_family: Smooth f:S^9 x R^{k+l}->R; only critical point 0; f=q_{k,l} near 0; smooth degree-two homogeneous at infinity; k,l>=20 and l>k+9 after stabilization.
definitions.annulus: Y x [0,1], Y=S^{k+l-1}, radius r(t)>0 with r'(t)>0; f=r^2 s, and s is t-independent on both end collars.
definitions.Sigma: {q=0} intersect Y, identified with S^{k-1} x S^{l-1}.
definitions.C: C_b={s_b=0}; incoming boundary identified with the fixed Sigma.
definitions.band: R_b={|s_b|<=epsilon}, with a family diffeomorphism C_b x J->R_b preserving s_b as the J coordinate and the fixed incoming collar.
definitions.W: (Y x [-1,0]) union R_b, with incoming Y x {-1}, inside Y x [-1,2].
definitions.sigma_faces: C^- x J has incoming X x {-1} x J, fixed vertical X x [-1,0] x boundary J, and outgoing (N x J) union (C x boundary J), followed by compatible bending.
definitions.extension: For codimension-zero e:X->Y, glue the h-cobordism to the trivial complement cylinder, equivalently replace the incoming collar by Y x I.
definitions.Morse_family: 0 is a regular value of the full vertical-gradient map d_wF, not necessarily of its restriction to each fiber.

C9000340.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 340 ('A counterexample to the nearby Lagrangian conjecture', unformalized in Lean), which claims to construct a closed exact smoothly embedded Lagrangian in T*(S^9 x S^(N-1)) diffeomorphic to the base but not Hamiltonian isotopic to the zero section: specifically audit all sign, orientation, Maslov/Morse index, and Eliashberg-Murphy / tube-surgery conventions in sections/tubes.tex, sections/morse.tex, sections/obstruction.tex, sections/embedding.tex, and sections/transport.tex, and either (a) certify a rigorous refutation/gap (such as a sign or orientation error analogous to the retracted split abelian eightfolds manuscript), or (b) independently certify the exact obstruction and surgery calculations.

MS-main.statement: For some sufficiently large even N, Q=S^9 x S^{N-1} admits a closed exact embedded Lagrangian diffeomorphic to Q but not compactly supported Hamiltonian isotopic to the zero section.
MS-main.scope_note: Corollary 2 of the transport audit composes the accepted realization and full obstruction with the new direct transport implication. This is a prose verification of the manuscript conclusion, not an independently approved new counterexample or a novelty certification. The transport implication and this composition still require Host-invoked review.

MS-tube-fibration.statement: The specified stable smooth tube space fits into Hs(*)->T->BG, and its rigid quadratic map BO->T composes with gamma to BJ.
MS-tube-fibration.scope_note: The existing independent review supports the actual negative-domain classifier, balanced component, left/right stabilization convention, finite index shift, collared standard-ball comparison and rigid negative-eigenspace map. Its primary-source assumptions are retained. No finite-stage partition equivalence or gradient-normal-invariant substitution is asserted.

MS-kernel-class.statement: There is nonzero a in pi_9(T) with gamma_*(a)=0, and BJ_*:pi_9(BO)->pi_9(BG) is injective.
MS-kernel-class.scope_note: The Engineer verifies the exact-sequence degree shifts using the one-loop Whitehead convention. Adams alone gives the order-two J_9 image and J_8 injectivity. After two-localization the unknown boundary has image of order at most four in an order-32 group, so its cokernel injects into the spherical kernel and has order at least eight. The 64-map calculation is universal; it does not compute the actual boundary map or a numerical tube representative.

MS-localized-family.statement: The kernel class has smooth finite-stage representatives, for arbitrarily large m>=20, standard near the two height critical points of S^9, with uniform linear vertical gradient bounds and a linear mixed-derivative bound.
MS-localized-family.engineer_assessment: The compact telescope map reaches a finite stage. A degree-one collapse supported away from both height poles and relative angular smoothing preserve its nonzero stable class and spherical nullity. Compactness gives the uniform bounds, including the C1 extension of d_b g at the origin. No finite representative dimension is invented.

MS-one-critical.statement: For B=S^9 and p>=20, a smooth family on R^{2p} homogeneous at infinity of type T_{p,p}, with exactly one smoothly varying nondegenerate critical point and trivial stable spherical infinity class, has trivial stable tube infinity class.
MS-one-critical.engineer_assessment: The Host-invoked Reviewer accepted the full proposition under the actual variable-infinity hypotheses on 2026-11-05. The existing ledger already contains the independent supporting judgement. This mission preserves that verdict without reopening its proof.

MS-morse-sublevels.statement: For k,l>=3, a smooth family over a compact smooth base, with one critical point at zero of value zero, equal near zero to possibly varying nondegenerate quadratic forms Q_b, and with uniform smooth homogeneous infinity data of type T_{k,l}, has Morse index k; its negative eigensphere bundle is fiber homotopy equivalent over the base to its negative infinity domains.
MS-morse-sublevels.engineer_assessment: The proof permits varying unframed local quadratic forms. Adapted bundle metrics make the relative handle construction global; the actual negative-sphere map is defined by a uniformly transverse flow over all parameters.

MS-local-normalization.statement: Under the hypotheses of one-critical, compactly supported modifications and a logarithmic radial insertion make the unique critical point 0 and its local form the fixed q_{p,p}, without changing infinity data or adding critical points.
MS-local-normalization.locator: Normalization and the negative sphere bundle
MS-local-normalization.engineer_assessment: Explicit cutoff bounds and a logarithmic insertion homotopy preserve the unique nondegenerate critical point at every time. Finite Grassmannian connectivity is proved from Stiefel and sphere fibers. No kernel-class existence assertion is used.

MS-stabilization-smoothing.statement: A smooth F at uniformly bounded C^1 vertical distance from g(w)+q'(z), where the homogeneous g has a linear positive gradient lower bound, can be made smooth homogeneous outside a larger ball without changing critical points or the regular homogeneous homotopy class.
MS-stabilization-smoothing.engineer_assessment: All four normalized gradient-error terms, including both differentiated-cutoff terms, are retained. Critical-point preservation is uniform throughout the homotopy. Intermediate functions have a controlled regular homogeneous reference; exact homogeneity is restored at the endpoint before applying the accepted zero-band theorem. Exactly ten positive squares suffice.

MS-signed-flows.statement: For the normalized annular family and sufficiently small uniform epsilon, the sign regions admit smooth parameter-dependent fields with +/-df(V)>0, dt(V)>0 near the ends, and +/-ds(V)>0 on their band side, with a common whole-sphere end prescription.
MS-signed-flows.engineer_assessment: Supported by the parametric field construction and exact differential/sign identities; independent review pending.

MS-residual-hcob.statement: The negative flow embeds the fixed incoming truncated negative tube by a homotopy equivalence into the outgoing one; the complement is the zero-level family C, a smooth family of h-cobordisms with fixed incoming Sigma.
MS-residual-hcob.engineer_assessment: The needed fixed-local-model Morse comparison and h-cobordism argument are proved within the audit, rather than assuming the broader manuscript Morse lemma.

MS-band-is-stabilization.statement: The entire family W, including its fixed incoming collar and transition maps, represents e_!(sigma(C)) for the single interval product stabilization specified in obstruction.tex.
MS-band-is-stabilization.engineer_assessment: The collar pushout, both movable side faces, and lower/upper seam transition maps are explicitly identified; independent review pending.

MS-product-complement.statement: The complement of W in Y x [-1,2], with compatible corner rounding, is smoothly over the full parameter space a cylinder on the varying outgoing boundary E; hence W is an incoming-relative product family.
MS-product-complement.engineer_assessment: A global flow product over the varying entry bundle and natural collar absorption are proved without trivializing that bundle in advance; independent review pending.

MS-hcob-injectivity.statement: For k,l>=20 and a collar e:Sigma x J->S^{k+l-1}, the composite H(Sigma)->H(Sigma x J)->H(Y)->Hs(Y) is an isomorphism on pi_9 in the product component and detects null free sphere families.
MS-hcob-injectivity.engineer_assessment: The r=10 stability threshold is 35 versus dimension at least 38; stable extension is at least 18-connected. Free nullity is detected without assuming a trivial outgoing bundle. Independent review pending.

MS-core-straightening.statement: If C is incoming-relatively trivial and l>k+9, shrinking its collar and disk fibers, normal linearization, and relative parametric general position deform the negative tube family to a fixed tube.
MS-core-straightening.locator: Completion of the proof of prop:one-critical
MS-core-straightening.engineer_assessment: Normal-bundle dilation and positive metric interpolation discard rather than extend a normal framing. The relative embedding homotopy is proved by doubling time, imposing equal parameters in the multijet bad locus, and cutting off only inside existing embedding collars. Its uniform normal radius is justified by compactness.

MS-generating-map.statement: A Morse family defines an exact Lagrangian immersion of its critical locus by (q,w)->(q,d_qF), with primitive the restricted F.
MS-generating-map.engineer_assessment: The transpose argument proves immersion from full vertical-gradient surjectivity, not invertibility of each fiber Hessian. The primitive has the stated sign for lambda=p dq and omega=d lambda.

MS-embedded-realization.statement: The localized kernel family is realized by a smooth Morse family on (S^9 x S^{N-1}) x R^N, unchanged at infinity, whose generating map is an embedding of a critical locus diffeomorphic to S^9 x S^{N-1}.
MS-embedded-realization.engineer_assessment: Explicit uniform K, Lambda and T choices exclude all inner and outer cutoff critical points. A full-gradient right inverse works even with singular fiber Hessians. Sphere momenta reduce every collision to w-w'=t v; the base-momentum estimate treats the entire segment, including zero and the origin-smoothing region. The remaining height-pole neighborhoods have unique quadratic solutions. Compactness and the primitive -g finish the embedding proof. Its critical locus is diffeomorphic to the base, not asserted to project diffeomorphically to it.

MS-transport-cylinder-extension.statement: A hypothetical Hamiltonian isotopy from the zero section to L has a compactly supported reverse extension in the Euclidean cotangent cylinder, fixing radial positions along its L-cylinder and ending at the zero section on a central slab.
MS-transport-cylinder-extension.engineer_assessment: The reverse Hamiltonian is -H_(1-t) with no conjugation for the path phi_(1-t) phi_1^(-1). The global momentum bound is established before using the radial cutoff plateau, fixes every radial slice and prevents unwanted cylinder points from entering the central zero graph. Independent review is pending.

MS-transport-mixed-generator.statement: A sufficiently C^1-small compactly supported Hamiltonian increment has global mixed coordinates (X,p) and a compactly supported generator sigma with x=X+sigma_p, P=p+sigma_X, invertible I+sigma_pX, and uniformly controlled spatial support.
MS-transport-mixed-generator.engineer_assessment: The action sign and both mixed graph signs are derived from lambda=p dq. Global mixed coordinates follow from a co-Lipschitz proper map. A common compact support projection and the flow bounds fix the subdivision before any generating family is changed.

MS-transport-step.statement: Each sufficiently small transport step preserves the generated critical-locus parametrization, regularity and controlled homogeneous infinity data, adding a fixed split quadratic stabilization and a regular homogeneous homotopy.
MS-transport-step.scope_note: The direct proof keeps all cutoff terms and both spatial cases. Outside the generator support, auxiliary p=zeta_1 p_old is not mistaken for the generated momentum. Full-gradient regularity uses a block right inverse without an inverse old fiber Hessian. Uniform bounded full-vertical error permits the already accepted smoothing operation. No AIS hypothesis is assumed or certified.

MS-final-Hessian.statement: A regular generating family whose critical-locus projection to the zero-section base is a diffeomorphism has exactly one smoothly varying critical point per base and invertible vertical Hessian.
MS-final-Hessian.engineer_assessment: Full regularity identifies the tangent space with the kernel of the critical equation. A vertical Hessian-kernel vector is then a tangent vector killed by the diffeomorphic base projection, hence zero. The quartic local model demonstrates why mere setwise uniqueness would not suffice.

ZB-product-convention.statement: The manuscript's bent-collar interval product and codimension-zero extension agree, on families and transition maps, with the operations in the cited WJR and CP sources.
ZB-product-convention.scope_note: CP2025 v1 explicitly selects lower stabilization. The author-hosted WJR PDF has 2012 creation metadata, so it is corroborating evidence, not a purported inspection of the final 2013 edition. The manuscript-to-source family comparison is proved separately in proof.tex.

ZB-stability-input.statement: For the specified product stabilization, H(X)->Hs(X) is r-connected when dim X>=max(2r+8,3r+5), and a d-connected map induces a (d-1)-connected stable h-cobordism map.
ZB-stability-input.scope_note: Theorem 2.16 and Theorem 2.17 were read in the exact cited arXiv v1. They are external assumptions, with independent citation attribution pending; the computational verifier checks only their arithmetic application.

ZB-deduction.statement: Under the normalized hypotheses actually obtained from one-critical, W represents e_!(sigma(c_B)), is an incoming-relative product family, and injectivity implies c_B=0 as a free S^9-family in H(Sigma).
ZB-deduction.scope_note: The sealed Host-invoked Reviewer accepted this bounded normalized deduction. Its approval is not approval of upstream normalization, the full one-critical proposition, or MS-main. The separate formal citation archive remains outside the owned paths.

ZB-geometric-family.statement: For the annular data in CTX9000340-ZERO-BAND over any compact smooth B, the band is C x J with fixed incoming embedding; W has a smooth product complement over its varying outgoing bundle and is an incoming-relative product family. If C is an h-cobordism family, W is the family-compatible lower stabilization followed by extension.
ZB-geometric-family.engineer_assessment: Prose proof supplied, including smooth parameter dependence, transition maps, quadrant conormals and collar absorption. Not machine-checked topology.

ZB-normalized-hcob.statement: For the fixed-local-model normalized family over any compact B, the negative local core generates the negative sublevel homology; negative flow embeds the incoming truncated negative tube by a homotopy equivalence into the outgoing tube with residual C. Hence C is a smooth incoming-identified h-cobordism family.
ZB-normalized-hcob.engineer_assessment: Local relative-handle proof, signed-flow decomposition, excision, simple connectivity, and both boundary equivalences are supplied; topology inputs remain external.

ZB-parametric-vanishing.statement: For the normalized family over a compact d-manifold B, min(k,l)>=d+3 and k+l-2>=max(2d+10,3d+8) imply that C is a product family relative to its fixed incoming boundary, using the recorded connectivity and classification inputs.
ZB-parametric-vanishing.engineer_assessment: General parameter-space theorem proving the requested sphere case as a corollary; novelty and independent acceptance not established.

ZB-exact-calculations.statement: The retained differential, collar-sign, sphere-gradient, local-handle, corner-conormal, product-boundary and dimension calculations hold exactly; the specified Jacobian polynomial on its rational box has range [1/8,24]. These checks do not certify the topology.
ZB-exact-calculations.engineer_assessment: All 11 exact check groups passed; five substantive certificate mutations were rejected. Independent replay pending.

OC-J8.statement: The stable spherical fibration map induces an injection pi_9(BO)->pi_9(BG), namely stable J_8. This does not assert existence of a nonzero stable tube-kernel class.
OC-J8.scope_note: Primary source obtained and its precise mod-two e_R statement read. The assumption is recorded under OC-Adams-J8. No J_9, Rognes, or nonzero-kernel calculation is used.

OC-exact-calculations.statement: The retained differential identities, quantitative error budgets, Taylor-jet normal-linearization identity and universal dimension inequalities hold exactly. The Jacobian polynomial is the normalized smoothing-gradient margin on its four-budget rational box. No topology is machine-verified.

The bounded Jacobian call returned [1/2,1], with exit 0, no timeout and no structured error. Independent replay is pending; this certificate cannot replace the topological proof.

TR-model-comparison.statement: The manuscript C1 regular-angular component computes smooth unframed negative-domain families. Its balanced stabilization agrees with the cited stable tube component, with the negative-core spherical classifier and rigid J-map, but without a finite-stage partition equivalence.
TR-model-comparison.scope_note: The proof supplies relative regularity-preserving smoothing, convex defining-function lifting, simplex-wise exact homogeneous ambient isotopies, a collared relative standard-ball argument, the shifts a=k-1 and b=l-1, and component/left-right convention checks. The spherical classifier is not the twisted derivative.

TR-universal-kernel.statement: Every homomorphism (Z/2)^3 -> (Z/2)^2 + Z/8 killing a specified nonzero vector has image of order at most four and cokernel of order at least eight; its cokernel surjects onto Z/4. The five possible cokernel types and their 64-map multiplicities are exactly certified.
TR-universal-kernel.scope_note: The verifier builds every homomorphism and quotient and finds a bijective homomorphism from each asserted cyclic product. The actual topological boundary map is not supplied or selected.

TR-exact-calculations.statement: The universal finite-group calculation, exact quotient replay, degree and component arithmetic, cutoff/momenta identities, strict parameter margins, full-gradient scalar block identity and two adversarial local models pass exact replay. Imported topology and the global geometric proof are not machine-verified.
TR-exact-calculations.scope_note: Ten exact calculation groups pass, covering all 64 abstract maps; eighteen substantive certificate/adapter mutations are rejected. The single bounded Jacobian operation abelian_group.quotient.compute returns C4 for the canonical H/H[2], not for an invented image of the connecting map.

TR-existence.statement: For some even N>=40 the stated Morse family on (S^9 x S^(N-1)) x R^N has a compact critical locus diffeomorphic to the base and a closed exact embedded generating map, with nonzero spherically trivial stable tube infinity class on every S^9 slice.
TR-existence.scope_note: The existing Host-invoked review independently supports this bounded realization goal and its exact calculations. Its ledger judgement is preserved, not reissued. It does not by itself prove non-Hamiltonian-isotopy, transport, novelty or final campaign acceptance.

HT-cutoff-regularity.statement: The complete cutoff equations give precisely the transported critical locus, with full-gradient regularity even at singular old fiber Hessians and throughout the spatial-boundary transition.
HT-cutoff-regularity.scope_note: Equations (17)-(26) retain every differentiated cutoff. The dimension-independent block right-inverse identity passed exact symbolic replay, and the separately inspected Jacobian scalar-jet product is diag(a*u+c*v,1,1). Local exact models distinguish full regularity from fiber Hessian invertibility and generated momentum from auxiliary momentum. The global smooth argument remains prose and independent review is pending.

HT-uniform-infinity.statement: Explicit uniform value and full-vertical error bounds allow the accepted smoothing lemma to preserve the entire critical germ. A fixed split quadratic path preserves the actual varying tube class. Evolving family constants never require refinement of the Hamiltonian-fixed finite subdivision.
HT-uniform-infinity.scope_note: The bounds include derivatives of both beta and chi and do not claim compact support in all vertical variables. The split path has squared gradient margin at least 4/5. Its parameter independence and the regular smoothing homotopy preserve the fixed S^9 class, not merely its signature or spherical image.

HT-transport.statement: A hypothetical compactly supported Hamiltonian isotopy of the accepted realization to the zero section yields, on every fixed S^9 x {v0} slice, a smooth family on R^(2p), p>=20, with one smooth nondegenerate critical section, uniform smooth homogeneous balanced infinity data, and the original nonzero spherically trivial free stable tube class.
HT-transport.scope_note: This is the current bounded goal and the missing mathematical implication. The route is direct, not a purported AIS application. The composition with the two accepted theorems is stated at MS-main; both new conclusions await Host-invoked independent review.
